permissionQuery: SELECT customer_no FROM customers ORDER BY customer_no

sampleQueries.name: 客户总数
sampleQueries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers

sampleQueries.name: 各营业部客户数
sampleQueries.sql: SELECT department_code,COUNT(DISTINCT customer_no) AS n FROM fund_accounts GROUP BY department_code ORDER BY department_code

sampleQueries.name: 证券成交 JOIN
sampleQueries.sql: SELECT t.id,c.name,s.code,t.amount_cents FROM trades t JOIN customers c ON c.customer_no=t.customer_no JOIN securities s ON s.code=t.security_code ORDER BY t.id LIMIT 20

sampleQueries.name: CTE 资金汇总
sampleQueries.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT customer_no,SUM(amount_cents) AS total FROM cash_flows GROUP BY customer_no) SELECT * FROM s ORDER BY customer_no LIMIT 10

sampleQueries.name: 员工范围
sampleQueries.sql: SELECT employee_id,emp_no,name,status FROM employees ORDER BY employee_id

forbiddenQueries.name: 拒绝 CTE 写入
forbiddenQueries.sql: WITH x AS (SELECT 1) DELETE FROM customers

forbiddenQueries.name: 拒绝 CTE 覆盖表名
forbiddenQueries.sql: WITH customers AS (SELECT 1 AS id) SELECT * FROM customers
